info.name: DF Catalog API
info.description:
REST API collection for the Raft Data Platform (RDP) Catalog service. Provides endpoints for managing datasources, enablements, datasets, storages, and related resources.

This collection includes both TOP-LEVEL routes (preferred) and NESTED routes (deprecated but still functional).

item.name: Enablements (Top-Level)
item.description: Top-level endpoints for managing datasource enablements. PREFERRED over nested routes.

item.name: Enablements (Nested - Deprecated)
item.description: Nested endpoints under /datasources/{id}/enablements. DEPRECATED - use top-level /enablements instead.

item.name: Datasets (Top-Level)
item.description: Top-level endpoints for managing datasets. PREFERRED over nested routes.

item.name: Datasets (Nested - Deprecated)
item.description: Nested endpoints under /datasources/{id}/enablements/{eid}/datasets. DEPRECATED - use top-level /datasets instead.

item.name: Filters
item.description: Endpoints for managing dataset filters (requires Kafka storage)

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Custom KSQL Filter",
  "acronym": "CKF",
  "description": "Advanced filtering with custom KSQL",
  "labels": ["custom"],
  "ksqlQuery": "SELECT * FROM source_stream WHERE speed > 65 AND fuel_level < 20"
}

item.name: Storages (Top-Level)
item.description: Top-level endpoints for managing dataset storages. PREFERRED over nested routes.

item.name: Storages (Nested - Deprecated)
item.description: Nested endpoints under /datasources/{id}/enablements/{eid}/datasets/{did}/storages. DEPRECATED - use top-level /storages instead.
